info.name: Perfume Shop API
info.description:
Run **0. Auth › Get token** first: it stores the Bearer token for every other request.
Token login only exists in local development. Variables (baseUrl, orderId, productId, variantId...) are on the collection.
Run **Orders › List orders** and **Products › List products** to fill `orderId` / `productId` automatically.

request.description: Local development only. Fill the `password` collection variable first (the ADMIN_PASSWORD from backend/.env).
Tick the query parameters you want. Sort: newest, price_asc, price_desc, name.

exec: const d = pm.response.json().data; if (d.length) pm.collectionVariables.set('slug', d[0].slug)
const v = pm.response.json().data.variants; if (v.length) pm.collectionVariables.set('variantId', v[0].id)

request.description: Re-prices the cart from the database. Prices sent by the client are ignored.
Creates a pending order (5 per minute per IP). The `website` field is a honeypot: leave it out.
Response includes `counts` per status for the tabs. Tick the filters you want.

exec: const d = pm.response.json().data; if (d.length) pm.collectionVariables.set('orderId', d[0].id)
const d = pm.response.json().data; if (d.length) pm.collectionVariables.set('productId', d[0].id)

request.description: Stock cannot be set here: use Stock › Receive stock.

request.description: Send the full list of `variants`; include `id` to update an existing size. Sizes left out are removed (or deactivated if they have history).
jpg / png / webp, 5 MB max. Resized to 1200 px and stored as WebP.
Completed immediately; stock is deducted at once. The response has `change_due`.
